EmailTemplate.name: QCC Email Bounced Back
EmailTemplate.subject: Your enquiry with Qantas
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello,
Thanks for getting in touch with Qantas.
It appears your reference ID is not attached to your correspondence or invalid. If this is in regards to a current case, please reply to the email associated to the case with the reference number included. If this is in relation to a new matter, please submit this feedback through the Customer Care form on Qantas.com. Please note that the information provided in this email will not be retained by Qantas.
Kind regards, Qantas Customer Care
{!Case.Custom_Thread_ID__c} Qantas Airways Limited, ABN 16 009 661 901 10 Bourke Road Mascot NSW 2020 Australia | qantas.com
